# anyways.

> anyways. is a South African performance marketing agency for DTC (direct-to-consumer) and lead-gen brands. We find what's broken in your marketing, tell you straight, and fix it, week after week. Every engagement starts with a free audit delivered within 24 hours. Founded and run by Wessel Breunissen.

Key facts:
- Name: anyways. (always lowercase, always with the period)
- Type: performance marketing agency
- Country: South Africa (serves clients across South Africa)
- Website: https://anyways.co.za/
- Email: wessel@anyways.co.za
- Free audit: 30-second form at https://anyways.co.za/#start, answer within 24 hours, no card, no obligation
- Free 30-minute video call: https://cal.com/wessel-gf9gk1/30min
- Channels: Google Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, Meta (Facebook, Instagram), TikTok, Klaviyo email and SMS, Shopify, WordPress
- Method: Say it (24-hour audit) → Pivot (plan ranked by impact, live the same week) → Fix (weekly tests and weekly reports until the number moves)

## Prices (ZAR)
- Website creation: R15,000 once-off, live in 5 working days
- Social media marketing management (includes Meta ads management): R7,500 per month, ad spend paid by the client
- Content production: half day R4,500 (5 edited videos, 15 edited photos); full day R9,000 (10 edited videos, 30 edited photos)
- Google Ads, Meta, Shopify and email growth work: priced per plan, before work starts

## Services
- [Google Ads](https://anyways.co.za/google-ads): anyways. runs Google Search, Performance Max, Shopping and YouTube campaigns for South African DTC and lead-gen brands. Every account starts with a 24-hour audit that says what's broken, then we fix it and report on the number that matters every week.
- [Meta ads](https://anyways.co.za/meta-ads): anyways. runs Facebook and Instagram ads, plus TikTok, for South African brands that need sales, leads or bookings. We build campaigns around an offer that converts, test new creative angles every week and measure everything on cost per result.
- [Social media management](https://anyways.co.za/social-media-management): Social media marketing management from anyways. costs R7,500 a month. We plan your content, write the posts, captions and hooks, and set up, run and optimise your Meta ads, with a monthly report on what actually moved.
- [Website design](https://anyways.co.za/website-design): anyways. builds websites for South African businesses for R15,000 once-off. Custom design, built mobile-first, with your bookings, shop or enquiry form connected, SEO basics and tracking set up, live in 5 working days.
- [Content production](https://anyways.co.za/content-production): anyways. films and photographs your business for ads and social. A half day is R4,500 for 5 edited videos and 15 edited photos. A full day is R9,000 for 10 edited videos and 30 edited photos. Shot list and hooks are planned with you before the shoot.
- [Shopify stores](https://anyways.co.za/shopify): anyways. builds Shopify stores for South African DTC brands and fixes the ones that don't convert. Store builds, CRO, product feeds, tracking and the Klaviyo email that brings buyers back, from one team.
- [AI creative studio](https://anyways.co.za/ai-creative): Ads wear out. anyways. runs an AI creative studio that makes new statics, UGC-style ads and short-form video every week, briefed from the numbers, so your Meta, TikTok and Google campaigns always have fresh angles to test.
- [Email & SMS](https://anyways.co.za/email-marketing): anyways. sets up and runs Klaviyo email and SMS for South African brands: the automated flows that make money in the background, and campaigns for launches and sales like Black Friday.

## Work
- [The Collective Club](https://anyways.co.za/work/the-collective-club) (Pilates club · Cape Town): New site live in under a week. Shoots, ads and emails right behind it.
- [Praia Eyewear](https://anyways.co.za/work/praia-eyewear) (Sunglasses · Shopify): A full Black Friday campaign: ads, email, Google and Meta, ready before the drop.

# https://anyways.co.za/google-ads

anyways. / Services / Google Ads
Google Ads agency in South Africa .
Clicks, budget gone, no sales… anyways . We find the wasted spend, fix the tracking and rebuild around searches that buy.
anyways. runs Google Search, Performance Max, Shopping and YouTube campaigns for South African DTC and lead-gen brands. Every account starts with a 24-hour audit that says what's broken, then we fix it and report on the number that matters every week.
Get your free audit →
The usual bad part
Spend on searches that never buy. Broad keywords and no negatives, so the budget goes to people looking for jobs, free stuff or a different product.
Tracking you can't trust. Conversions counted twice, or not at all, so Google's bidding is optimising for the wrong thing.
Performance Max as a black box. A campaign that spends happily on your own brand name and calls it growth.
Messy shopping feeds. Products disapproved or showing for the wrong searches because titles and attributes were never cleaned up.
What we do in Google Ads
Search campaigns built around buying intent, with tight keyword themes, negatives and ads that match the landing page.
Performance Max and Shopping with a cleaned-up Merchant Center feed, brand traffic kept separate and asset groups that make sense.
YouTube for reach and remarketing, cut from the same creative that's working on social.
Conversion tracking through GA4 and Google Tag Manager, server-side where it matters, so bidding learns from real sales and leads.
Landing pages fixed or rebuilt when the page is the reason clicks don't convert.
How it works: Say it. Pivot. Fix.
Say it. A 24-hour audit of your account, tracking and landing pages. We tell you straight what's broken.
Pivot. A plan ranked by impact, live the same week. Wasted spend gets cut first.
Fix. Weekly tests and a weekly report on sales, leads or bookings, not impressions.
Recent Google work
For The Collective Club , a Pilates club in Cape Town, we rebuilt Google Search alongside Meta, with purchases tracked server-side from the payment. For Praia Eyewear we ran a Black Friday search campaign next to Meta ads measured on cost per sale.
Questions
How much should I spend on Google Ads?
It depends on what clicks cost in your category and how many sales or leads you need. Your free audit includes a recommended starting budget based on your market. Ad spend is paid by you, straight to Google.
How long before Google Ads works?
Search campaigns can bring buyers from the first day. Performance Max and automated bidding usually need a few weeks of clean conversion data before they settle, which is why we fix tracking first.
Do you run Performance Max and Shopping campaigns?
Yes. We clean up the Merchant Center feed, keep brand searches separate so results aren't flattered, and report on new sales.
Can you take over an existing Google Ads account?
Yes. You keep ownership of the account. We start with an audit of what's there and change what's costing you money first.
Get your free audit .
Tell us the bad part in a 30-second form. Within 24 hours you get a straight answer on what's broken and a first plan to fix it. No pitch deck, no card.
Get your free audit → Book a free 30-minute call
Or email wessel@anyways.co.za .

# https://anyways.co.za/meta-ads

anyways. / Services / Meta ads
Meta ads agency in South Africa .
Boosted posts, cheap clicks, no buyers… anyways . Offers that convert, fresh angles every week, and tracking Meta can learn from.
anyways. runs Facebook and Instagram ads, plus TikTok, for South African brands that need sales, leads or bookings. We build campaigns around an offer that converts, test new creative angles every week and measure everything on cost per result.
Get your free audit →
The usual bad part
Creative fatigue. The same three ads running for months while results slowly get worse.
Leads that never pick up the phone. Cheap instant-form leads that look great in the dashboard and never buy.
Broken signal. No Conversions API, so Meta can't see who actually bought and optimises for the wrong people.
Too many campaigns. Budget split so thin that nothing ever leaves the learning phase.
What we do on Meta
Account structure simple enough for Meta's delivery to learn: fewer campaigns, clear budgets, one goal each.
Weekly creative testing of new hooks and angles, made by our AI creative studio and from shoot days .
Offers and landing pages that give people a reason to act now.
Pixel and Conversions API set up properly, server-side from your checkout or payment provider where we can.
TikTok and Instagram Reels when your buyers are there.
How it works: Say it. Pivot. Fix.
Say it. A 24-hour audit of your ads, creative, tracking and funnel.
Pivot. A plan ranked by impact, live the same week.
Fix. New angles tested every week and a weekly report on cost per sale, lead or booking.
Recent Meta work
For The Collective Club we shot the club, made the ads and rebuilt Meta with purchases sent server-side from the payment. For Praia Eyewear we made six Black Friday statics in every size plus UGC reels, measured on cost per sale.
Want us to run your social as well as the ads? See social media management , from R7,500 a month.
Questions
Do you run Facebook and Instagram ads together?
Yes. Facebook and Instagram are both Meta, so they run from the same campaigns. We add TikTok when it suits your audience.
Who makes the ads?
We do. New statics, UGC-style ads and short-form video every week from our AI creative studio, plus footage from shoot days at your business.
What does Meta ads management cost?
Social media marketing management, which includes running your Meta ads, starts at R7,500 a month. Ad spend is paid by you, straight to Meta. Bigger growth work gets a clear price with your plan.
Do you set up the Conversions API?
Yes. Without it Meta misses a lot of your sales. We connect it server-side from your store or payment provider where possible.
Get your free audit .
Tell us the bad part in a 30-second form. Within 24 hours you get a straight answer on what's broken and a first plan to fix it. No pitch deck, no card.
Get your free audit → Book a free 30-minute call
Or email wessel@anyways.co.za .

The usual bad part
Content for the sake of content. Posting because you should, not because it brings anyone in.
No hooks. Good businesses with posts nobody stops scrolling for.
Organic and ads in separate worlds. The posts that work never get budget behind them.
How we run it
We plan each month around what sells for you, write hooks built to stop the scroll, and put ad budget behind the posts that are already working. Need footage? Add a content shoot day from R4,500. Need more than social? See Meta ads and Google Ads .

Instagram and Facebook as standard, with TikTok when your customers are there.

# https://anyways.co.za/website-design

anyways. / Services / Website design
Websites that turn visitors into customers .
A pretty site that nobody books from… anyways . A fast site that looks the part and turns visitors into bookings, leads or sales.
anyways. builds websites for South African businesses for R15,000 once-off. Custom design, built mobile-first, with your bookings, shop or enquiry form connected, SEO basics and tracking set up, live in 5 working days.
Get your free audit →
What's included for R15,000
Custom design, built mobile-first
Bookings, shop or enquiry form connected
SEO basics and tracking set up (Meta Pixel, GA4)
Live in 5 working days
Start your site for R15,000 →
The usual bad part
Slow on phones, which is where most of your visitors are.
No clear next step. People land, look around and leave without booking or buying.
Invisible to Google and AI search. No titles, descriptions or structured data, so search engines can't tell what you do.
No tracking, so ads can't learn and you can't tell what's working.
Built for search, ads and AI answers
Every site ships with page titles and descriptions, structured data, a sitemap and an llms.txt file so Google, ChatGPT and Perplexity can read what you do. Tracking goes in from day one, ready for Google Ads and Meta ads . Selling online? See Shopify stores .
Recent website work
The Collective Club , a new Pilates club in Cape Town, had a Bali brand and no Cape Town site. We built a new WordPress site with Glofox bookings, live in under a week, that the team edits themselves.
Questions
How much does a website cost in South Africa?
Our website creation package is R15,000 once-off, including custom design, a connected booking, shop or enquiry form, SEO basics and tracking.
How long does it take to build a website?
5 working days from when we have your content and logins.
Can I edit the website myself?
Yes. We set it up so your team can change text and images without a developer.
Do you do SEO on the website?
Every site includes SEO basics: titles, descriptions, structured data, a sitemap, fast loading and tracking.

The usual bad part
Product pages that don't answer the question. No sizing, no delivery info, no reason to buy today.
Slow themes and too many apps, especially on mobile data.
Broken tracking, so Google and Meta can't tell which ads bring sales.
No email flows, so every abandoned cart is gone for good.
What we do on Shopify
Full Shopify store builds, designed mobile-first
CRO: product pages, collections, cart and checkout tested to turn more visitors into buyers
Clean product feeds for Google Shopping and Performance Max
Meta Pixel, Conversions API and GA4 set up properly
Klaviyo welcome, abandoned cart and post-purchase flows (see email & SMS )

AI creative studio for ads that need to keep changing .
Same three ads for six months… anyways . New statics, UGC-style ads and short-form video every week, briefed from what's selling.
Ads wear out. anyways. runs an AI creative studio that makes new statics, UGC-style ads and short-form video every week, briefed from the numbers, so your Meta, TikTok and Google campaigns always have fresh angles to test.
Get your free audit →
What the studio makes
Statics in feed, square and story sizes, built around one clear hook each.
UGC-style ads and creator-style edits.
Short-form video for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.
Retouching and grading so AI work and real shoot footage look like one brand.
Briefed from what's selling
Every week we look at which hooks and angles are winning in your Meta ads and Google campaigns and brief the next round from that. Real products and real people stay real: we use AI to make more variations, faster, not to fake reviews or results.
For the strongest results we mix studio work with footage from a shoot day at your business.
Questions
What is AI ad creative?
Ad images and videos made with AI tools and edited by people, so you can test many more angles every week than a traditional shoot allows.
Will the ads look fake?
Not if they're done properly. We retouch and grade everything to your brand, and keep real products and real footage real.
Is AI creative included in ads management?
Creative is part of how we run ads. The volume you need gets priced in your plan.

# https://anyways.co.za/email-marketing

anyways. / Services / Email & SMS
Email and SMS that bring buyers back .
A list of thousands, one newsletter a year… anyways . Klaviyo flows and campaigns that turn first-time buyers into regulars.
anyways. sets up and runs Klaviyo email and SMS for South African brands: the automated flows that make money in the background, and campaigns for launches and sales like Black Friday.
Get your free audit →
The flows we build first
Welcome: turns a new subscriber into a first order.
Abandoned cart and browse: brings back people who nearly bought.
Post-purchase: reviews, cross-sells and the second order.
Win-back: for customers who've gone quiet.
Lead nurture for service businesses: from first enquiry to booking.
Campaigns that land
Designed emails for launches and sales, like the early-access Black Friday email we made for Praia Eyewear . For The Collective Club we built nurture flows that walk a lead from a first class to a membership.
Email works best with steady new subscribers, so we usually pair it with Meta ads and a store or site that captures emails properly ( Shopify , websites ).
Questions
Which email platform do you use?
Klaviyo for most online stores. We can work with what you have if it does the job.
Do you do SMS too?
Yes, through Klaviyo, for the moments where SMS beats email, like flash sales and delivery updates.
Do you write and design the emails?
Yes. Copy, design, setup and reporting.
